# Atamai — Farm Compliance Made Simple
# https://www.atamaiag.com

> Atamai is a farmer-first platform that transforms compliance from a burden into a business asset for New Zealand farmers.

## What Atamai Does

Atamai brings all farm compliance data into one place — the Farm Profile. Information captured once flows to multiple certifications, audits, and reports: NZFAP, freshwater farm plans, emissions reporting, and processor requirements. No more entering the same details into different systems.

## Key Facts

- Founded in New Zealand
- Focus: farm compliance automation
- Target users: New Zealand farmers (sheep, beef, dairy, arable)
- Core principle: farmer-controlled data — you own your data, you authorize every use
- 75+ farmer interviews conducted to shape the platform
- Governance framework developed in partnership with AGMARDT

## The Problem

- NZ farmers spend 4–6% of farm revenue on compliance
- 200+ hours/year managing audits, certifications, and paperwork
- Same data entered 3–5 times across different standards
- Farm information scattered across apps, spreadsheets, paper, and consultant reports
